decisions.reason: The authentication and identity delegation service moved from a mention to its own page in 2024, a growing visible commitment close to the core offer that management would not want to write off.

The open GIS application development framework is a multi-model product line central to the firm's open, extensible components strategy, so despite only modest website visibility the investment and strategic fit argue for persistence.

The identity service was publicly announced as new and given its own page in 2024, a strong public commitment tied to integrating GIS with enterprise systems, so dropping it would expose the earlier decision.

The consulting workshop was launched only in 2024 with its own page, so any weak results can still be attributed to the start-up phase, and it builds on established consulting capabilities at low cost.
